integrity: The claim is supported by a complete analytic proof and a standalone exact-rational checker. This is not an independent validation or a claim of literature-exhaustive priority.
scientific_limitations: Positive finite three-arm theta metric graphs only; ideal full distance distribution, with no finite-sample stability theorem. Comparison with the complete 2018 Mémoli–Needham manuscript remains limited by inaccessible full text.
title: Distance histograms globally reconstruct every positive three-path theta graph
